description: Link log datasets to websites so investigations and Databunny read them, or unlink them. Preview shows what each website would read; apply after the user approves. Adding a link a website already has replaces its scope.

add.description: Links to add, such as suggestions from get_log_connection.

scope.description: Read only lines whose field holds one of the values, for a dataset several websites share. Copy it from a suggestion; omit to read every line.

websiteId.description: Website ID from list_websites or list_integrations.

confirmed.description: Preview first; set true after user approval to apply the displayed change.

remove.description: Link IDs to unlink, from list_integrations.

name: update_log_links

outputSchema.description: message describes the outcome. preview and confirmationRequired identify a review without writing; current and updates show proposed edits when present. links lists every link the connection has after the change; success confirms an applied mutation.

title: Update log links
